Movement adds meaning. I explore the space between graphic design and animation — where simple shapes become stories and every frame has a feeling.
I'm Mukesh Singh, the creative mind behind Singh Creative Studio. I love exploring strong composition, expressive color and visual storytelling to turn rough ideas into polished creative directions.
This space is where I share design explorations and build visual experiences with a little more character and motion energy.
Have a brand, campaign or creative idea in mind? Let's turn that first spark into something people remember.
